raw_answer_text: Python's core language design philosophy emphasizes code readability, simplicity, and explicit syntax over implicit magic, as famously summarized in The Zen of Python (PEP 20). In contrast, system languages like Rust prioritize memory safety without garbage collection through its ownership model, as documented in https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ for the Rust programming language.
